title: AI Skill Evaluation Event Schema
description: Standardized schema for recording AI skill task execution and evaluation results.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this evaluation event (UUIDv4) used for idempotency.

task_id.description: Pseudonymous identifier for the task instance.

skill_id.description: The identifier of the AI skill being evaluated.

task_type.description: Category/type of task (e.g. prd_analysis, frd_analysis, brd_analysis).

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the evaluation event occurred.

evaluation_status.description: Whether the output could be evaluated.

result.description: Evaluation outcome based on rubric thresholds.

evaluation_method.description: Methodology used to grade this event.

issues.description: List of structured issue codes detected (e.g. missing_gherkin_acceptance_criteria).

rework_required.description: Indicates if the output required notable revisions.

feedback.description: Optional high-level feedback or note without raw user content.
